_comment: Registry of oops' OWN feature switches (called 'features' in the API and the frontend). Consumed by the Python backend (dbcore/feature_flags.py) and the Qwik frontend (apps/web/src/lib/features.ts). Source of truth in production is PostHog; the PostHog flag key is POSTHOG_FLAG_PREFIX + key (default prefix 'oops-', because one PostHog project is shared with the other 3m4 apps). `default` is the fail-safe used when PostHog is unreachable or the flag is undefined there; self-host (no POSTHOG_API_KEY) enables everything unless a flag sets `self_host` explicitly (used by inverse-polarity flags like site-building, where ON hides the product).

site-building.description: Site-wide building/under-construction curtain. ON = the whole web UI shows the building page. The API, the ingest endpoints, the SDK script and the MCP server are unaffected. Inverse polarity: OFF is normal operation.

signups.description: New account registration. Login is NEVER gated.

early-access.description: Early access mode. ON = every account gets the enterprise limits for free, plan/billing surfaces are hidden and an early-access notice is shown. OFF = plans and limits are enforced as configured.

public-api.description: Management API access via X-API-Key (and therefore the MCP server). Dashboard sessions and the ingest endpoints are not affected.

ingest-api.description: The public ingest endpoints (/api/ingest, /api/ingest/batch). OFF answers 503 to every SDK and server-side reporter: an emergency kill switch, never a feature gate.

billing.description: Paywall, checkout and /billing/offerings. The RevenueCat webhook is NEVER gated.
